data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate records a gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 25.5m in 2017, driven by favourable development on older underwriting years (notably 2014 and 2015) as shown in the gross claims development table. This release represents a c.23.1% reduction relative to the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2017. No specific large named events are identified as the driver in the narrative; the movement is reflected in the claims development triangle and attributed to favourable development/IBNR recalibration.
raw_causal_phrases: variations in the severity or frequency of claims
Claims development tables are shown on an underwriting year basis below.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) printed in the notes. The triangle was parsed and current estimates per underwriting year were extracted (2014 and 2015 used for PYD calculation; 2016 and 2017 excluded per methodology). There is no explicit single-sentence gross prior-year movement in the narrative; 'Claims incurred in prior accident years' figures appear in the P&L but are NOT used (these are P&L claims incurred, not PYD). The syndicate has related reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transactions noted in the accounts which can distort development patterns; this may affect comparability. Confidence is moderate-high for the gross triangle extraction but moderate due to potential RITC effects.
